quotations.old_english: Ðrítig gefolra olfend-myrena mid heora coltum
quotations.english: thirty milch camels [camelos fætas] with their colts

source_text: ge-fole; adj. Having a foal, milch :-- Ðrítig gefolra olfend-myrena mid heora coltum thirty milch camels [camelos fætas] with their colts, Gen. 32, 15.
